description: Total Residential Solar Sites in San Mateo County 1998 - 2014 is a dataset listed in County of San Mateo open data portal (datahub.smcgov.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by County of San Mateo. Counts of the total number of residential photovoltaic solar energy installations on residences in San Mateo County from 1998 - 2014. Data includes annual and grand totals. This data is for photovoltaic generation sites authorized to parallel under Rule 21 Programs. The data was supplied directly to the County by PG&E. Coverage: San Mateo County, California. The portal files it under the category Environment. Its tags are solar, electricity, pg&e, energy. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E). The portal shows 2014-09-09 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-smcgov-org-portal.
